symbols.phrase: Look deep here, this fat fish swims through muddy waters bringing pure golden fortune.
See this sharp key carved into the porcelain, ready to unlock long-closed gilded chambers.
A majestic bird takes wing at the cup's rim, carrying whispers of glorious triumph.
Behold this steep mountain summit, proving you shall soon stand victorious above all worldly storms.
This blooming tree firmly branches outward, promising fruitful abundance and generational wealth for your house.
Right at your heart shines a radiant star, blessing your steps with untouchable, glittering destiny.

conclusion: Ah, my precious soul, your cup breathes the sweet incense of an extraordinary turning tide. From the shadowed silt rises the great fish of fortune, placing into your trembling hands the key that unlocks long-sought abundance. You are called to ascend the great mountain without fear, guided by the shining star that has taken residence in your very core. Above you, the falcon flies swiftly toward the heavens to herald your victories to the world, while below, your roots blossom into a sacred tree of lasting prosperity. Step forward with head held high, for the universe has woven a mantle of gold and honor just for your shoulders.
